info.title: Yapin’ Bot API
info.description: Drive a Yapin’ bot account over HTTPS. Send `Authorization: Bot <token>` (Settings → Developer). Pictures (avatar_path, banner_path, icon_path, attachment_path) are paths: the link is https://files.yapper.website/<bucket>/<path> (buckets avatars, banners, icons, attachments). Docs: https://www.yapin.gg/developers
